name: Bodyweight squats
prompt: A trail runner, wearing loose, fully-covering outdoor running layers (long sleeves, leggings or joggers) and trail running shoes, performs bodyweight squats facing the camera with the feet about shoulder-width apart and the toes pointing slightly outward, their face clearly visible and unobstructed the entire time, arms extended straight out in front at shoulder height for balance: the hips push back and down while the knees bend until the thighs are about parallel to the ground, the chest staying upright and the heels staying flat on the ground, then pushing back up through the feet to a fully standing position, with no jumping and both feet staying planted the entire time, in a flat mossy clearing just off a forest trail, sunlight filtering through the canopy in dappled patches, tall evergreen trees surrounding the clearing, a gentle river visible through the trees nearby, morning mist. Cinematic, polished outdoor lifestyle video, natural light, shallow depth of field, filmed from a single fixed camera position the entire time — the camera never moves and the subject never turns, reorients, or changes position relative to the camera. They repeat the full motion continuously, four complete repetitions, all from this one consistent front-facing angle. Vertical video, about 6 seconds, one continuous shot, photorealistic, G-rated, no on-screen text or watermark.
